title: Yo o Tlhophilweng ka Botlhale
intro: Mo moriting wa thaba e mafoko a bomodimo a neng a fologela mo go yone, tumelo ya batho e ne e reketla ka fa tlase ga go phatsima ga gauta. Moya o le mongwe, o o nang le mpho ya botswerere jwa go bua, o ne wa ema jaaka tshegetso ya thomo e kgolwane, le fa go ntse jalo o ne wa lebana le motsotso wa teko e e tseneletseng. Fa morongwa yo o tlhophilweng a ne a tlhatlogela kwa go tlhomilweng go go boitshepo, setshwantsho seno se ne se sala kwa morago, se kopa setšhaba se se sa iketlang. Moya o o tlhomameng ono o lentswe la one le neng la tsoga kgatlhanong le kobamelo ya medimo ya disetwa ke mang?
clues: Ke tlhophilwe ke Allah go nna moporofeti, le fa kgang ya me gantsi e anelwa mmogo le e nngwe.
Ke ne ka romelwa kwa mmusi yo o bogateledi, mme seabe sa me e ne e le go ema nokeng, e seng go etelela pele.
Ke ne ke na le mpho ya go bua ka botswerere, mme mafoko a me a ne a diretswe go nolofatsa dipelo.
Fa molekane wa me a ne a tsamaya go ya go dira peelanonako e e boitshepo, ke ne ka sala ke kaela batho ba ba neng ba sa iketla.
Ka go tlhoka bopelotelele ga bone, ba ne ba dira setshwantsho ka mekgabiso ya bone, mme ke ne ka ba kopa gore ba nne ba ikanyega mo go Allah.
Molekane wa me o ne a boa mme a ntshwara, mme ke ne ka mo tlhalosetsa gore batho ba ne ba ntlhola mme ba batla ba mpolaya; Ke ne ke se mongwe wa badiraphoso.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go lebana le tiragalo ya namane ya gauta
Teko ya bolwetse jo bo masisi
Teko ya go latlhegelwa ke khumo le bana
trial.answer: Go lebana le tiragalo ya namane ya gauta

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
